concerns.advisory: Widening `USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH` from `protected` to `public` promotes an internal auth-note key into the effectively-public surface of `AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator`, which third-party authenticators can then depend on and which becomes hard to rename or remove later.
concerns.why: services/.../AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator.java: `protected static final String USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH` → `public static final`, imported statically by AuthenticatorUtils.

concerns.advisory: The change flips user-visible login behavior for existing deployments — passkey/WebAuthn UI is now rendered on the username/password screen during re-authentication where it was previously suppressed — but the diff contains no release-note, upgrading-guide, or docs update.
concerns.why: PasskeysOrganizationAuthenticationTest assertions inverted from `Assert.assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, ...)` to `assertThat(driver.findElement(By.xpath("//form[@id='webauth']")), notNullValue())`, with the comment changed to "Passkeys still enabled"; no docs files touched.

concerns.advisory: `UsernameForm` no longer short-circuits with `context.success()` when the user is already set and conditional passkeys are enabled, so every re-authentication in flows using UsernameForm now renders an extra form round-trip that previously was skipped.

The guard for `fillContextForm` in `UsernamePasswordForm.authenticate` was inverted from "user is not already selected" to requiring `user != null`, so the anonymous first-visit path now depends entirely on a separate conditional-UI execution being present in the flow to populate passkey data — custom flows without that execution silently lose the passkey UI on the initial login page.
concerns.why: services/.../UsernamePasswordForm.java: the old `if (webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled())` inside the user-not-selected block is replaced by top-level `if (isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()))`, where the helper requires `user != null`.

concerns.advisory: `fillContextForm` is now invoked on every username/password challenge and on every error re-render when passkeys are enabled and a user is set, adding WebAuthn challenge generation and auth-session writes to paths that previously did none.
concerns.why: services/.../UsernamePasswordForm.java: `fillContextForm` added to both `authenticate` (unconditional on the user-set path) and `challenge(context, error, field)`; plus `WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.createErrorResponse` now also calls it after the new util call.

concerns.advisory: The new `shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators(context)` extension point decouples the null-check from the `user` dereference immediately below it, so any subclass overriding it to return true without a user will NPE inside `WebAuthnAuthenticatorsBean`.
concerns.why: services/.../WebAuthnAuthenticator.java: `if (user != null)` replaced by `if (shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators(context))` while the body still uses the separately-captured `user` variable.

concerns.advisory: Rendering discoverable-credential (conditional UI) passkey login on a re-authentication screen where a specific user is already bound means the browser may return an assertion for a different account; no test asserts that a passkey belonging to another user is rejected or does not silently switch the re-authenticated identity.
concerns.why: New tests (`webauthnLoginWithExternalKey_reauthentication`, `..._reauthenticationWithPasswordOrPasskey`) only exercise the same user's passkey during `prompt=login`.

concerns.advisory: `AuthenticatorUtils.setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError` is exercised only indirectly; no test asserts that `USERNAME_HIDDEN` / `REGISTRATION_DISABLED` are actually set after a failed passkey attempt in the conditional-UI error path it was added to.
concerns.why: The new call in `WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.createErrorResponse` has no corresponding assertion; the new tests only check the presence of the `webauth` form and the info message.

concerns.advisory: The new absence assertions use `try { assertThat(driver.findElement(...), nullValue()); fail(...); } catch (Exception nsee) {}`, which swallows any exception — including unrelated WebDriver or assertion failures — and can mask real regressions, unlike the `assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, ...)` idiom the same PR removes elsewhere.

`reauthenticationOfUserWithoutPasskey` newly couples this passkey test class to the shared default test realm user `test-user@localhost` (via the added `configureTestRealm(realmRepresentation)` call in `addTestRealms`), making it sensitive to changes in shared realm fixtures.
concerns.why: PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest: `configureTestRealm(realmRepresentation);` added to `addTestRealms`, and the new test logs in and looks up `test-user@localhost` via `ApiUtil.findUserByUsernameId`.

concerns.advisory: The `events.clear()` that previously followed `logout()` was dropped in the refactored external-key test, so the reworked test now asserts against an event queue that still holds registration/login events from earlier steps, increasing the chance of order-dependent flakiness.
concerns.why: PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest, `webauthnLoginWithExternalKey_reauthenticationWithPasswordOrPasskey`: `logout();` retained but the adjacent `events.clear();` line was removed.

concerns.advisory: `AuthenticatorUtils` (in `authenticators.util`) now statically imports a constant from `authenticators.browser`, introducing a dependency from the shared utility package back onto the browser authenticator package.
